name: Poliflex
description: Uruguayan mattress and sommier manufacturer selling online and through a showroom in Montevideo. Lists double-sensation, hybrid, extra-support and adjustable mattresses, bed bases and pillows. States nationwide shipping with times varying by location; free shipping above a stated cart threshold.
description_es: Fabricante uruguayo de colchones y sommiers que vende online y a través de un showroom en Montevideo. Ofrece colchones de doble sensación, híbridos, de extra soporte y articulables, bases de cama y almohadas. Indica envíos a todo el país, con plazos según la localidad, y envío gratis por encima de un monto indicado en el carrito.

ships_to.notes: States it delivers to all of the country; times vary by locality. Free shipping above a cart threshold (about UYU 8,000 shown in the cart).

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Showroom in Montevideo (Cam. Manuel M. Flores 8672); pickup at the showroom is implied by the site but not confirmed in detail.
